title: Dinner Lady Fruit Full Pineapple Ice 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Dinner Lady’s Fruit Full Pineapple Ice delivers a bright and refreshing fusion of tropical fruit and cooling Menthol. The bold, golden sweetness of ripe Pineapple brings a juicy and tangy burst of flavour, while an icy finish adds a crisp, cooling sensation that leaves a clean and uplifting aftertaste. Part of the Fruit Full Bar Salts collection, Pineapple Ice is designed to replicate the bold, intense flavours often found in disposable vapes. Using a double-concentrated Nic Salt formula, this e-liquid ensures long-lasting flavour while maintaining a consistently satisfying vape. Blended at 50VG/50PG, this e-liquid strikes a balance between vapour production and flavour intensity, making it ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping. The nicotine salt formulation provides a smooth throat hit and rapid nicotine satisfaction, making it best suited for use with pod kits and classic vape starter devices. Since 2016, Dinner Lady has been crafting high-quality e-liquids that have earned worldwide recognition. With distribution in over 80 countries, their expertly blended flavours continue to be a favourite among vapers seeking bold and satisfying e-liquids.
